subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM to replace the italicised word.**

His *extravagant *pretensions only served to excite ridicule.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Economical**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**extravagant**" means excessive or wasteful. (अत्यधिक या बेकार)

 
 
• **For example- ***His claims became more extravagant and he used oil as a weapon*.
 
 
 
• "**Economical**" means frugal or efficie
